conclusions.finding: The same row protocol and hdp/ou/oe structures occur in esports and conventional sports. Esports is not inherently winner-only.
Within this snapshot each of 1079 group codes identifies one game, one raw stage, one tag and one group name; multiple concrete lines coexist under the same event/group.
tag=win is not synonymous with match winner: first blood and races to five/ten kills are also win.
tag=ou is numeric threshold syntax but the metric varies: map count, kills, rounds, towers, duration, goals, points and team totals are distinct propositions.
win/hdp use event team IDs; ou/oe/ab/select/crs/mselect have team_id=0 in all observed rows, so team_id is not a universal side identifier.
wdl has three choices including draw; select/crs/acrs/outright support more than two; mselect double-chance outcomes overlap.
The raw stages goals and others are UI-like groupings, not unambiguous settlement periods: football 15-minute windows use others, and full/half correct score groups both use goals.
Basketball has both bo4 and bo1 source labels; do not infer universal period count from the round field.

Use a common RAY raw decoder and option store; a group-code semantic registry provides period, metric, target, conditions, outcome structure, overtime and settlement. Keep an N-option representation and adapt verified two-sided markets to existing arb interfaces.

Concrete market identity needs event + semantic proposition + period/window + target + threshold/directional handicap + settlement policy. Same tag and same line alone do not imply equivalent markets.

limitations: Snapshot covers every event returned by the available credential on match_type 1/2/3 at capture time, not every historical or globally available RAY market.

Raw group names help identify propositions but are not a substitute for official settlement rules. Definitions such as tie, void, cancellation, overtime and quarter-line payouts were not verified by placing bets.
Syntactically paired numeric options do not by themselves prove economic hedge compatibility.
Prefix semantics in ahdp values such as 0-0,+0.25 remain unverified; preserve the full raw value.
No product code changed; no orders, account prechecks, database writes or production collector changes were performed.
